svg.title: How run-skills is put together
svg.desc: On your machine, you ask a coding agent for a run. The agent reads the remote-run skill, whose index is built from one directory per target, and runs the harness: local commands that sync the code and build the environment, and rsk, which plans each launch on the target, checks it against what you already allowed, then submits it or asks you, and reads the run's status. On each Slurm cluster or GPU workstation, your project directory holds the code and the deployed harness: the submit or launch scripts, the site's policy on a cluster, and a status script that returns a small digest. Logs, checkpoints and model and wandb caches stay there; the environment does too unless the target's storage policy moves it.
